meta.description: SMS-administered caregiver assessment instruments used by GiveCare

instruments.name: gc_sdoh6
instruments.title: GC-SDOH-6
instruments.description: Quick 6-question baseline assessment covering social determinants of health for caregivers. One question per domain, deficit-framed (0=none, 4=extreme).

questions.prompt: How much financial strain is caregiving causing?
How often do you feel alone in caregiving?
How much has your own health worsened?
How unstable does your home situation feel?
How hard is it to navigate care systems right now?
How overwhelmed do you feel today?

instruments.name: ema3
instruments.title: EMA-3 Reading
instruments.description: 3-item ecological momentary assessment reported separately from the structural GiveCare Score.
instruments.cadence: Twice weekly initially, then weekly; daily only for an explicit short burst

questions.prompt: How stressed do you feel right now? (0=none, 4=extreme)
How would you rate your mood right now? (0=very low, 4=great)
How well are you coping today? (0=not at all, 4=very well)

instruments.name: gc_sdoh30
instruments.title: GC-SDOH-30
instruments.description: 30-item deep-dive instrument aligned to GC1-GC6 domains (5 questions per domain). Administered selectively per flagged domain, not as a full battery. Informed by PRAPARE/AHC-HRSN methodology.
instruments.cadence: Triggered when inverted GC-SDOH-6 domain scores are below 40 on the 0-100 GiveCare Score scale

questions.prompt: How often do you feel you have no one to talk to about caregiving?
How hard is it to find someone to step in when you need a break?
How often do you feel isolated because of your caregiving role?
How difficult is it to ask family or friends for help?
How often do you feel you handle everything alone?
How much has caregiving worsened your physical health?
How often are you too exhausted to take care of yourself?
How hard is it to get enough sleep because of caregiving?
How often do you skip your own medical appointments?
How much does caregiving interfere with eating well or exercising?
How unstable does your living situation feel right now?
How hard is it to keep up with home repairs or maintenance?
How often do safety or accessibility issues at home affect caregiving?
How difficult is it to get reliable transportation for care needs?
How much does your neighborhood lack services you need?
How much financial strain is caregiving causing you?
How often do costs prevent you from getting needed care help?
How hard is it to find affordable caregiving support?
How much has caregiving reduced your income or work hours?
How worried are you about long-term financial security?
How hard is it to understand or navigate care system options?
How often do confusing rules or paperwork slow you down?
How difficult is it to find trustworthy information about benefits?
How hard is it to deal with legal, insurance, or government forms?
How often do you feel lost trying to coordinate between providers?
How overwhelmed do you feel by your caregiving responsibilities?
How often do you feel anxious or worried about the future?
How hard is it to find time for things that bring you joy?
How often do you feel guilty about how you handle caregiving?
How much has caregiving affected your sense of who you are?

scoring.method: GiveCare Score uses GC-SDOH-6 as its structural base and completed GC-SDOH-30 questions to refine matching GC domains. EMA-3 is normalized separately as an EMA-3 reading.

composite.name: GiveCare Score
composite.normalization: Deficit-framed SDOH items are inverted before domain and composite scoring; EMA-3 is excluded.
composite.sdoh30_trigger: Trigger deep-dive questions for domains scoring below 40 on the inverted 0-100 scale.
